headline: The 1,900-address email went out at noon from a domain that has no SPF and no DMARC — ≥74 bounces in the first ten minutes — while the first-ever showing on the $1.15M listing is in the house right now and the 11:00 appraisal on the $899K file came and went without a signal · DO: add SPF to both domains, five minutes at the DNS host · WATCH: 1,689 more addresses are staged for tomorrow.

notes: 🔴 THE NOON SEND IS THE STORY, AND THE PROBLEM IS NOT THE COPY — IT IS THE DOMAIN. All 24 batches left between 11:51 and 12:00 CT: 1,900 unique addresses, zero duplicates, draft folder emptied. The copy defect this desk raised at 9:32 was fixed before the send and the listing status is stated correctly to all 1,900. But a direct DNS lookup at 12:30 confirms the sending domain has NO SPF record and NO DMARC record, and ≥74 hard bounces landed inside ten minutes — a ~3.9% floor against the ~5% where mailbox providers start throttling. Nothing is throttled or blacklisted; no such signal exists. This is exposure, not damage, and today is the window to keep it that way. The honest miss: this desk watched the copy and the sweeps watched the volume, and nobody checked whether the domain could authenticate.

✅ THE OUTAGE FIX SHIPPED THIS MORNING AFTER TWO WEEKS ON THE BUILD LIST. Catch-up-on-reopen — missed critical runs fire once, in order, the moment the app returns — went in at Gene's one-word approval and is off the board. It was earned: the app was dark 6:31 PM Tuesday to 7:17 AM Wednesday, the third outage in six days, and five morning routines simply never started. That window is still inside the 24-hour read, which is why this board says alert while the log reads clean — a routine that never starts cannot report a failure.

✅ SINCE 7:17 AM THE FLEET HAS RUN CLEAN — zero BLOCKED lines, one deliberate PARTIAL (the forwarding fix, root cause nailed and handed back to Gene). The Daily landed 7:45, the opportunity board auto-sent to all eight, the milestone engine fired the 2127 showing at 8:05 and ran a quiet midday pass, and two Delta passes executed nine of Gene's own commands. Nothing has arrived from ShowingTime since 5:27 PM yesterday, so no buyer signal went unread and the showing board needed no new alerts.
